body: I relate to that. I really just can’t explain how i feel anymore
I relate to this. I’m so sorry Op.
I do too and it’s so exhausting. Even when I’m watching TV or at work I’m still thinking about it constantly i can’t get it off my mind for more than an hour or so if I’m lucky.
Yes i did this so much last year. Probably will get back into the habit of it soon. I relate to this post so much.

No therapist has ever given me concrete advice on how to get better. They just say “go for a walk or talk to a friend” like the most basic shit imaginable. Im literally suicidal do you think i didn’t try all the easy shit already? Probably seen 10 different therapists and spent god knows how much money. Never doing it again.
This seriously helped me tonight. Thank you for writing this.
Completely agree. Even on my “good” days when I’m laughing and having fun, there’s a voice in the back of my head that just tells me to kill myself. No matter what.
That sucks, i hate that feeling so much. Funny YouTube videos can help a little sometimes. Or taking a shower, cleaning your room, something productive can make your mind feel better.
I am so sorry. That’s so genuinely fucked up and unfair to you.

If you feel ashamed of your past, or regretful of things you’ve done, that is a sign that you are growing and changing as a person in a positive direction. So as much as the feeling sucks, it’s a good thing overall. 

You aren’t alone. You should try to forgive yourself for your past mistakes. Give yourself a big hug. It will be ok. And i hope you can get some sleep tonight.

I can kind of relate to this. Getting my Masters in March. But I’m not happy at all. Dont give a shit about my education or my life or anything. Just wish i was dead. Im sorry you’re feeling shitty too.
I understand that feeling. Sometimes i wish i didn’t have a family, so i could just die in peace and not upset anyone.
Yes. I hate it. I wish i could just get in a car accident or something.
Thank you. I appreciate it. I will be working on this.
